params.name: recommendations_id
params.description:
This parameter indicates the unique identifier associated with the recommendation created in the recommendation module.

You can obtain the `recommendation_id` from the recommendation you created on the recommendation page.

items.docs: This API retrieves the metadata associated with a specific recommendation setup using its unique ID. The metadata can include the recommendation name, model type, status, creation and update time, and so on.
